questions.sectionTitle: Module 2: Control Flow, Iteration Protocols & Defensive Error Handling Checkpoint
questions.prompt: What will the expression 'None and print("Hello")' output?

options.text: It prints nothing and evaluates to None due to short-circuit evaluation.
It raises a TypeError because None cannot be combined with a function call.

questions.explanation: Because None is falsy, the 'and' operator short-circuits immediately without evaluating the right operand.

questions.prompt: In Python 3.10+ structural pattern matching, what is the role of the '_' pattern?

options.text: It declares a private local variable.
It acts as a wildcard catch-all pattern matching any value.
It forces the match statement to loop back to the beginning.
It ignores whitespace in string matching.

questions.explanation: The wildcard '_' matches any value and is commonly used as the default branch at the end of a match block.

questions.prompt: What exception signals the termination of an iterator in Python?
questions.explanation: The Python iteration protocol specifies that __next__() raises StopIteration when no further items remain.

questions.sectionTitle: Module 2: Control Flow, Iteration Protocols & Defensive Error Handling Checkpoint
questions.prompt: What happens to a generator function's local execution frame when a 'yield' statement is executed?

options.text: The frame is destroyed and garbage collected immediately.
The frame is suspended and preserved in memory until next() is called or the generator is garbage collected.
The frame is serialized into a temporary disk file.
The frame is converted into a static tuple.

questions.explanation: Yield pauses the generator, preserving its local variable state, evaluation stack, and instruction pointer until resumption.
